name: Motor-Driven Cycle
description: Any motorcycle or motor scooter whose motor produces no more than 5 horsepower (3,750 W), and any bicycle with a motor attached that isn't an electric bicycle; one that can't reach more than 30 mph within a mile is a moped instead.

restrictions.rule: A motorcycle or motor scooter with a motor of no more than 5 horsepower (3,750 W) (New Hampshire RSA 259:65)
A pedaled bike with a motor outside the e-bike limits is a motor-driven cycle too (New Hampshire RSA 259:65)
One that can reach no more than 30 mph within a mile is a moped
Riders need a motorcycle license or endorsement, or a motorcycle learner's permit
Riders and passengers under 18 must wear a helmet
Riders need eyeglasses, goggles or a face shield unless a windshield protects their eyes and face
Can't go faster than 35 mph at night unless its headlamp shows a person or vehicle 300 feet ahead
Registered with a permit from the city or town and a state plate
